newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 1995/96 budget deficit seen lower.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 1995/96 budget deficit seen lower.

text.p: Sweden's national audit office on Friday revised its budget deficit forecast for the 18-month 1995/96 fiscal year to 159 billion crowns from 164 billion.
The office said it saw Sweden's borrowing requirement for calendar 1996 at 54 billion crowns compared to an earlier forecast of 59 billion.
The office's previous forecasts for both of the figures were announced in June.
The state budget's expenditure is now seen decreasing by two billion crowns due to a 2.9-billion crown drop in defence costs and a 2.4-billion crown fall in European Union membership costs.
Interest on the state debt increased by 4.5 billion crowns, the office said.
State revenue was seen three billion crowns higher, mainly due to increased tax from corporate Sweden.
